parameters.name: workUnitId
parameters.description: Stable identifier for the work unit.

parameters.name: planSummary
parameters.description: Planning output, routing notes, and dependencies.

events.postAction: ObserverTrace emits transition_begin/transition_end around Created -> Planned.

parameters.name: executor
parameters.description: Runtime or agent responsible for execution.

parameters.name: attempt
parameters.description: Execution attempt number for retry-aware flows.

events.preAction: Validate the planning envelope before entering Running.

events.description: Execution is waiting for human review.

parameters.name: reviewPacket
parameters.description: Human review bundle, evidence, and rationale.

events.preAction: Pause execution and prepare a human-readable review artifact.
events.postAction: Queue the work unit for HITL review and emit provenance.

events.description: A human approved the pending work.
A human rejected the pending work.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why the work unit was rejected.

parameters.name: resumeToken
parameters.description: Correlation token proving the review gate was cleared.

events.description: A failed or rejected unit was rescheduled.

events.postAction: Persist failure provenance before routing to retry or archive.

parameters.name: archiveUri
parameters.description: Location of archived provenance or artifacts.

states.name: Created
states.description: A work unit exists but has not been planned yet.

transitions.description: Capture planning intent, payload contracts, and retry metadata before execution begins.

states.name: Planned
states.description: The work unit has inputs, routing, and retry metadata.

transitions.description: Promote the planned work unit into active execution when runtime preconditions pass.

states.name: Running
states.description: Runtime adapters are actively executing the work unit.

transitions.description: Pause autonomous execution and route the work unit into a human review checkpoint.
Finalize the successful execution branch before archival.
Capture runtime failure context so recovery or archival can be decided explicitly.

states.name: WaitingForHITL
states.description: Execution is paused behind a human review gate.

transitions.description: Record approval provenance and allow the work unit to continue.
Record rejection rationale so the workflow can retry or terminate safely.

states.name: Approved
states.description: The work unit passed human review and can resume.

transitions.description: Resume the autonomous path after human approval has been preserved in provenance.

states.name: Rejected
states.description: The work unit was rejected and must be replanned or abandoned.

transitions.description: Route rejected work back through planning with explicit retry context.
Archive rejected work units that should not be retried.

states.name: Completed
states.description: Execution finished successfully and is ready for archival.

transitions.description: Persist provenance, outputs, and terminal metadata for completed work.

states.name: Failed
states.description: Execution failed and can either be retried or archived.

transitions.description: Re-enter planning with failure context so the next attempt is intentional.
Close out failed work units whose provenance should be retained without another attempt.

states.name: Archived
states.description: Execution lineage has been captured for provenance and replay.
